people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Edrei

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

translations.web: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
translations.bsb: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
translations.kjv: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
translations.asv: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Edrei.
